nvitk.transform.swap_axes
=========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.transform.swap_axes

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Swap or permute axes of an image volume.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.transform.swap_axes.permute_axes
   nvitk.transform.swap_axes.swap_axes


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: permute_axes(image: nvitk.types.Image | Any, order: Sequence[int]) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Reorder array axes to *order*.

   :param image: :class:`~nvitk.types.Image` or ndarray-like.
   :param order: New axis order. Must be a permutation of ``0..ndim-1``, or of
                 ``0..k-1`` to permute only the leading *k* axes (e.g. spatial of 4D).


.. py:function:: swap_axes(image: nvitk.types.Image | Any, axis0: int, axis1: int) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Swap two axes of a 2D/3D/4D image.

   :param image: :class:`~nvitk.types.Image` or ndarray-like.
   :param axis0: Axis indices to exchange (no-op if equal).
   :param axis1: Axis indices to exchange (no-op if equal).
